teachingPoints.objective: Interpret acquisition of knowledge versus its continuing state.

teachingPoints.objective: Use every beat of the eight-command memory aid with its infinitive mapping.
teachingPoints.prompt: Recall Di-Haz-Ve-Ven / Ten-Pon-Sal-Sé and map each beat to its infinitive.
teachingPoints.answer: Di → decir; haz → hacer; ve → ir; ven → venir; ten → tener; pon → poner; sal → salir; sé → ser.
teachingPoints.explanation: Di = tell; haz = do/make; ve = go; ven = come; ten = have; pon = put; sal = leave; sé = be. Every beat is a command form, with no skipped connective words. These are affirmative tú forms, not negative commands or formal address.
